headline: Heavy Fighting Concentrated on Nevish Line, Linn Mercy
war_summary: Since the evening wire the Nevish Line has quickened to 59 transfers on the day with ten in the last two hours to 1951, centred on Grief Mother, the Scrying Belt and Unruly, now counting three Warden and five Colonial posts on reported day losses of 11,999 Colonial and 14,085 Warden. Linn Mercy follows close with 40 on the day and four in two hours to 1958 about Rotdust, Outwich Ranch and Lathair, holding ten Colonial posts and one ruin. Callahan's Passage has stirred anew with two in two hours to 1935, 16 on the day all at Crumbling Post, holding nine Warden posts and one ruin amid sharply quickened losses. The Weathered Expanse has fallen silent with none in two hours, 43 on the day to 1555 about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Huntsfort, holding seven Warden posts and two ruins. Mooring County with 16 about the Wind Hills and Marban Hollow with 11 about Checkpoint Bua report nothing in six hours, while Briar in Stlican Shelf shows three to 1706 and Stonecradle reports no transfers in the day.
